links.outcome: Prospective validation of the model's rehospitalisation predictions after a pilot implementation at the hospital
links.effect: tZIP prediction of rehospitalisation from 28 to 365 days achieved above 80% discrimination accuracy retrospectively and prospectively in two out-of-sample cohorts, outperforming Cox and linear models.
links.quote: The tZIP prediction of rehospitalisation from 28 days to 365 days was achieved at above 80% discrimination accuracy retrospectively and prospectively in two out-of-sample cohorts.

screen.reason: The study prospective piloted/implemented the predictive model in live hospital operations to tag discharged patients and track outcomes, but focuses on validating model discrimination rather than testing an operational safeguard or deployment practice.
